description.value: Blenz Coffee is a BC-born specialty coffee chain founded in Vancouver in 1992, now operating locally owned and franchised cafés across Canada. The menu spans handcrafted espresso drinks, nitro coffee and tea, whole-leaf organic teas, protein shakes, and a broad food selection including croissants, sandwiches, samosas, and baked goods. A touring cyclist stopping in can expect a community-focused café atmosphere with a diverse range of beverages and snacks.

The contact page title references 'Coffee Shop Richmond' rather than North Vancouver, suggesting the corporate site does not surface per-location details useful for verification.
